title: Goodwill Cap on Marketplace Orders Northloop Guarantee Grants
content:
**Rule.** The goodwill credits of the Marketplace Orders guarantee grant are each decided on their own, added together, and then limited by the goodwill cap. The goodwill cap of the guarantee grant is a share of the amount claimed, worked out to the cent with half-up rounding before it is compared: where the amount claimed is at least the large-claim floor of USD 250.00, the goodwill credits paid never exceed the large-claim cap share of 0.15 (15%) of it; where it is at least the mid-claim floor of USD 100.00 but below USD 250.00, they never exceed the mid-claim cap share of 0.25 (25%) of it; otherwise they never exceed the whole amount claimed.

The goodwill credits paid are the lower of the credits added together and that cap; the cap applies to the credits only, before they are added to the amount claimed, and the net paid and claim-cap limits apply afterwards to the whole grant. The guarantee grant is the amount claimed plus the goodwill credits paid, never more than the order's net paid amount at decision time nor the option's claim cap, rounded half up to the cent and funded by Northloop.

## Cap by amount claimed

| Amount claimed | Goodwill cap |
|---|---|
| USD 250.00 or more | 15% of the amount claimed, rounded half up to the cent |
| USD 100.00 up to USD 249.99 | 25% of the amount claimed, rounded half up to the cent |
| below USD 100.00 | the whole amount claimed |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

1. Amount claimed USD 300.00, credits added USD 18.50: cap 15% of 300.00, that is USD 45.00; credits paid USD 18.50; grant 318.50, provided the net paid amount and claim cap are not lower.
2. Amount claimed USD 133.33, credits added USD 40.00: cap 25% of 133.33, that is 33.3325, rounded to USD 33.33; credits paid USD 33.33; grant USD 166.66 before the net paid and claim-cap limits.
3. Amount claimed USD 40.00, credits added USD 50.00: cap USD 40.00; credits paid USD 40.00; grant USD 80.00 before the limits.
4. Amount claimed USD 300.00, credits paid USD 18.50, net paid amount at decision time USD 310.00: 318.50 exceeds 310.00, so the grant is USD 310.00.
